federate command

Usage:
  zqk system federate [command]

Available Commands:
  handshake   handshake command
  initiate    initiate command
  status      Show the status of the federated sovereign mesh

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk system federate [command] --help" for more information about a command.
